LOOK_AT.say: A steel pen, nib down in its stand, cleaned. It has been cleaned today.
repeat: There is no blot anywhere on this counter. I have looked for one.
She writes down what she knows. It is apparently the entire discipline.
Nothing.
Nothing. It is a pen and it is between sentences.

LOOK_AT.say: THIS WINDOW CLOSES AT FOUR. Handwritten. The ink has faded but the sentiment has not.
repeat: Six years. The ink has gone and nobody has needed to read it in some time.
THIS WINDOW CLOSES AT FOUR. It closes at four.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It has been saying the same thing for six years and requires no assistance.
repeat: Nothing.
Nothing. It has said the same thing for six years and needed no help.

LOOK_AT.say: Eight months of names. Two-thirds of them in the same hand.
repeat: Two-thirds of these entries are in the same hand and the same ink.
Eight months. I have counted forward and I arrive in March.
Paper.
Nothing.

overrides.PICK_UP: That is the queue. Men have killed over less orderly things.

LOOK_AT.say: A territorial commission, framed, appointing W. LEDGER acting assayer.
repeat: Acting. Nine years of acting.
Somebody in a capital four hundred miles away has never got round to the other word.
then: The word acting has been there nine years.

repeat: Nothing.
Nothing at all.

overrides.PICK_UP: It is screwed to the wall, and it is hers.

LOOK_AT.say: An oil lamp hung directly over the ledger. Centered, naturally.
repeat: The light falls on the book and almost nowhere else.
It has been placed exactly where the work is.
Barely anything.
A faint wick hiss.

LOOK_AT.say: A floorboard. It sits a little proud of the others.
repeat: Proud by about the width of a nail head.
Every other board in this room is flush. She has not fixed this one.

LISTEN_TO.say: Loose. There's a space under it.
repeat: Still loose.
Loose. And nothing under it that rattles.

overrides.PULL: It gives, and stops. Somebody has arranged for it to give and stop.
overrides.OPEN: Not with her at the counter.

LOOK_AT.say: A balance, in a glass case, so accurate that men have wept in front of it.
repeat: Under glass. Nobody touches it but her.
I have watched a man watch this scale for four minutes without breathing.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing at all. It is the only instrument in Consolation that cannot be argued with.
repeat: Nothing.
Nothing at all. It cannot be argued with, and it knows.

overrides.PICK_UP: It is under glass, and I would not touch it if it were not.

LOOK_AT.say: The bench seats nine and holds two.
repeat: Seven empty places. The bench has not adjusted to the improvement.
It is still built for nine. The queue, for once, is not.
then: The queue has been on a diet since a certain log was read aloud.

LISTEN_TO.say: Two people shifting. There is room between them.
repeat: A board creaks. Nobody answers it.
Almost nothing. Waiting is quieter in small numbers.

overrides.USE: It seats nine. I have been all nine, on different days.
overrides.PUSH: Moving the bench does not move the queue. The queue is a spiritual object; the bench is merely where it condenses.

LOOK_AT.say: A small stove, lit, with a kettle on it that is not for tea. It is for the work.
repeat: The only warm thing in a cold room, and it is warm for the ore's sake rather than anybody's.
Somebody has swept the ash. Of course somebody has swept the ash.
Ticking.
Nothing. It has been let go out, and the room is colder for it.

overrides.OPEN: That is the work's fire. I am not opening it.

LOOK_AT.say: Vials, labelled, in rows, in order. Nine years of them and not one out of place.
repeat: Each one is somebody's morning. Somebody carried that up here in a fold of paper and waited.
I have looked for a gap. There is no gap.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. It is nine years of finished work and it is not asking for anything.
repeat: Nothing.
Nothing. Glass, in order, with nothing to add.

overrides.PICK_UP: Nine years, in order. I am not going to be the man who moves one.

LOOK_AT.say: The door out, plain, with a step worn pale in the middle.
repeat: The only unornamented front on the street, seen from the inside.
It shuts properly. Almost nothing in Consolation shuts properly.

LISTEN_TO.say: The street. Muffled. It sounds like a town from in here.
repeat: Still the street.
Somebody arguing about a boundary, a long way off.

repeat: It is shut and it is not locked, which are different facts.
There is a cot in there. I have seen the corner of it.
Nothing.
Nothing. She is not in there, and she is not going to be.
